reason: Correct all row-level false positives and false negatives found by independent Phase 1 acceptance attempts 1 and 2.

groups.name: finite_shape_internal_marker_or_tokenizer
groups.rationale: Only normalizes or tokenizes characters, parses a finite ID/date/directive/internal marker, or matches an exact finite sentinel/catalog alias; it does not infer open-ended prose meaning.
groups.deterministicOwner: the current source owner; regex may enforce only character-level or finite grammar

groups.name: persisted_migration_prose_inference
groups.rationale: Interprets persisted memory, error or scene-name prose to delete or rewrite migrated State; structured legacy fields or conservative defaults must decide instead.
groups.deterministicOwner: owning domain migration using explicit structured values or the approved conservative default

groups.name: actor_relationship_or_system_identity_inference
groups.rationale: Classifies free Actor prose as a generic relationship impression or backend narrator identity and changes validation/normalization.
groups.deterministicOwner: Actor, Social and Appraisal schemas, explicit system-role identity, evidence/ID guards and owning Reducers

groups.name: location_and_event_summary_meaning
groups.rationale: Interprets activity-clause priority or event-summary specificity from free prose and changes room inference, fallback text or paid-turn acceptance.
groups.deterministicOwner: Actor, room and Event evidence/ID guards plus owning Reducers

groups.name: translation_literal_role_inference
groups.rationale: Infers whether a Latin letter has a signature, compartment, initial or geometric semantic role in free prose and affects translation acceptance.
groups.deterministicOwner: source-token provenance plus translation acceptance and localization-state validators

groups.name: appraisal_error_text_classification
groups.rationale: Infers a structured rejection reason from free-form validation error prose instead of consuming an explicit error code.
groups.deterministicOwner: typed Appraisal validation error codes and deterministic reason mapping

groups.name: sensitive_field_name_inference
groups.rationale: Infers sensitivity from an open-ended field-name keyword rather than an explicit governed field registry.
groups.deterministicOwner: explicit save-revision and diagnostics sensitive-field registries

groups.name: process_log_severity_inference
groups.rationale: Infers process failure severity from unstructured Ollama stderr prose.
groups.deterministicOwner: process exit status and explicit Ollama health/readiness protocol

groups.name: uncalled_narrative_presence_filter
groups.rationale: Interprets Actor-presence prose and removes a complete narrative segment, but the exported helper has no current production caller.
groups.deterministicOwner: none; remove the uncalled exported narrative filter

groups.name: unreachable_private_key_pattern
groups.rationale: The only caller starts recursion with privatePath=true, so short-circuit evaluation makes this regex unreachable.
groups.deterministicOwner: none; the current storyArcs root is already explicitly private
